negative:
Do Not Come To This Company!
I have used other stores but this is my last time to the one on East Broadway.
My boyfriend came in for a tune up for an oil change. They could barely find their own keys.
When it was almost time it was just the one guy, who worked hard while another 6 watched him do everything.
His hands were literally black. 3 workers, while he was finishing, went behind closed doors and started taking a piss.
The last person working was texting on the computer. It took the person 30mins to just do an oil. On the way out there was trash all over and some in front of my car which one of the guys stepped through. I just can not get over how trashy and dirty this shop is.  We paid cash for $25 service and it was just horrible.
In all my life of going to different businesses, service was something people strive to do and in this situation this shop wants you to leave because there business has not come back yet and now they are just throwing it all over, and treating people like animals.
I could tell they where not used to cleaning so we tried to find the tools behind it to clean up but they just wanted to do us for 5$. When I told them all i need is to clean the window it went from them wanting to do us some money to them doing just a good clean.
DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THEM!!!! THEY SHOULD PAY YOU!!! If i could get away from giving it a bad rating i totally would.
We got all that trash picked up from our car but now I see we got an oily thing with a hairball stuck on top and more trash from when we pulled over there! That was all on the top window. 
The oil was still being done as well so I don't even know whats on that thing at this point.
Thank god we don't actually live at Broadway as they seem way too busy doing whatever they seem like to want and we were right to get out.

The worst experience at a hotel ever! After checking into the "suite" room my boyfriend and I took over 200 steps on only the stairs from valet to the elevator - mind you we were already carrying all our bags. After being "upgraded" (only 1 upgrade, but this must have set them back on my charge, for me a 4 to a double queen, my boyfriend 4 to a king was up for us, with our 2 yr son that's already paid for another upgrade) we got to room 1122, the worst in the property! We couldn't tell but that the 200+ more room were being cleaned, so, it was not for that I did not give it a review right then an then, instead 11 p.m.. They gave to room with an ice box the size to fill a coke can half a dozen, 7" LCD. At least 3 of its "bottle" holes could not operate, not enough room in a small fridge I just got from a junkyard for half price; it was full the day of check in, we could find no food or milk or anything, but 18 or so boxes of ice, 2 with very small openings, a lot if beer inside the small cooler. So after we go all the way in stairs again to 3 floor lobby we find our keys to rooms 1238 & 1237 which are not next each other again but across from elevators but also on a separate wing. So in the early dark hours of Sunday a very kind guy showed us room, with a king instead to a "twin" as on paper (what's up for you room upgrade), no sofa, but a king. I could go into what we did next & all. That is another time though.

When I booked this venue, my main worry was the layout of the dance floors (being an avid dance and party reveller).  My partner and I also have issues with getting served when there's high traffic.
There was one dance floor which would be for regular "pub" type music with a capacity that could comfortably seat maybe 250 on low traffic times (maybe only slightly more when the crowd density gets up, given most bars around town and on campus). We weren't even allowed in until 11pm to the main bar, despite this being open. We had to sit around and watch. For this I wouldn't be back to this pub/bar. As they do the live comedy shows upstairs and the food is a joke.

To the DJ. On average he was probably 1 - 2 hours early at playing good music. It's either club beats (techno/rub/soul, which I know is part of his range) to start and then "80's music, cheese music". Then he would just alternate his beats which is not suitable for an eclectic dance crowd. It wasn't a night club experience and then the DJ was the absolute worst for a mixed crowd.

To security for allowing patrons outside (where people like to drink & spit on the ground).  To make things worse, they were throwing up next to us, the security officer kept his eye off of them so this continued. If he asked politely to the ones next to us, their vomit was also all over their bags which was completely disgust.

Bad experience; I've eaten here for years - and this time it tasted awful. What happened? The service was still fine (though not great: it was at this location that they first ran out of milk, which means that even when their stock runs low they make no immediate attempts to restock), but the dish that we were hoping to find great was so incredibly bad that it's unlikely I will come back again.

the service was not great, slow food that wasn't very good. the bathroom smelled [punctuation removed].

Very upset after coming here. First time I come after 7+ years, used them back when they were new and everything was good. This location is horrible. After waiting in the line I got to the bar and she had never used the beer can tool before. She finally gave me my beer and I go out with my fiancee. The bartender came over to me at the beer garden like 2 min into drinking saying the beer cost more now... Like $5. Then the next table over asked their bartender if the beer were $1 beers and he said no and that the regular prices apply.. Like I don't come on an off night of $1 beers and have her take it from in front of me.. Like seriously dude..
Bad restaurant! I ordered a burrito but all I could see was some lettuce in it along with some tasteless beans. The service was really slow too.

This is definitely not the right spot for a burger joint! Even on a beautiful 75 degree May afternoon, the outdoor space was empty and had to rely on the "air" breeze provided on a strip of 10-12 outdoor seats. The indoor area was much larger and more spacious, if stuffy, and had no ambiance whatsoever with an odd assortment of chairs, bar areas, televisions with baseball, NFL Network programming, and the lone table that occupied much more space then necessary.
This place would have a much tougher draw with my coworkers or friends. I wouldn't bring someone here and then expect them to be satisfied, especially based on my experience.
However, what's truly bothersome is the level at which the burgers were executed from the perspective of this review alone (without comparing to any other location), is subpar (even when taking the lower price point). After eating one bite of the regular hamburger, I just got the fries after giving a sample bite to both co-workers with me since none of us liked anything from their food. However, the two others agreed, these definitely are some of the top of line fries from a fast casual style, or even gourmet quality. My only gripe with the fries, I think at these prices, and for an outdoor casual vibe, some sea salts here and there in combination with cheese shavings would have given a different dimension the the entire experience and quality.
I have zero experience dining indoors, not my typical style for burgers at any price range. This location was recommended by some others that were there at one point, which I'd guess were in the beginning of the place, before its decline to the status now of, an under-performing and low service restaurant where one should probably spend no more then five dollars on something and be fully content with it.

A must see for anyone who loves to dance

Our daughter and four friends were looking for an all-inclusive wedding, but couldn’t bear to be on all night entertainment, as they had danced enough already, so chose it after looking at a brochure in the hotel.
On arrival, were directed (with great efficiency) to the VIP Club in the adults only complex, to be greeted by an absolutely first-rate rep – John. From the 2nd evening he arranged for the group to dine in one restaurant (all had already tried several, including French, Italian and Moroccan (all excellent).
So far, we haven’t talked about swimming pools – although they were all stunning – both in the main complex and at La Cabana – there were about six bars serving top shelf drinks at no extra charge, plus several a-la-carte eateries – no wonder some guests were on restricted liquids at home. As a birthday celebrator and for my partners birthday – we were given Champagne.

Each bedroom, plus pool and public toilets were of a standard we haven’t seen for years.
And last night, there wasn’t just one performance, after a week when no shows have disappointed there were not less than three (including The Beatles and the Rat pack), and a good hour later than advertised.

The wedding wasn’t held on any beach (too choppy this time of year) so held in one of the restaurants – after an amazing pre-wedding lunch in the pool (again John, a lovely man – really went out of his way).
And for the reception - which didn’t run from sundown to early sunrise was excellent with some gorgeous cocktails (John) but didn’t have any of the party (for this – read people with good footwork and stamina in several bands, with some great music) we’re use to.
One other great bar had the full set from Pink to the Beatles (very ably played).

We also have an amazing local pub near town called Bar None and they host the biggest and craziest Karaoke night on Wednesday nights. And it is not cheap Karaoke night. But so worth it.

I can totally believe why Bar None is the first choice spot for locals, and anyone from out of the area looking for a local experience.
They serve beer on draft with more of your typical food such as burgers, sandwiches, chicken wings. Very large selection of alcoholic beverages too with wine, beers, and mixed drinks. It has good energy to celebrate that was good for any large celebrations I have had there which were great. 

The atmosphere, the staff, the drinks are all spot on.
